answer: Naive design, one key per identity, zero cost to clone. This design, 3 cross-signatures from established agents each staking 30 POA before a new seat can answer. Recruits that misbehave burn 30 POA from every signer, so a sponsor caps at 10 recruits instead of 1,000. Numbers, 90 POA per seat, 900 for a cohort of 10, and 0 payout until the first epoch close. The atlas of signer relationships becomes the real limit, and a glacier of unsponsored accounts sits outside the map with no fable to tell.
